campaign.name: W72Inplace
campaign.description: W72 inplace non-interference: v15 battlemd:inplace package whose [SOV1] Scenario is rewritten to the OFFICIAL Soviet first mission (SOV01UMD.MAP, uppercase spelling). Both arms therefore load the SAME official map; the only independent variable is that BATTLEMD.INI was rewritten by the inplace mechanism (.bak in place, manifest original_sha256). Package maps are INERT (never loaded).
